messages.content:
Relevant policy context:
- Shipping times: Standard shipping is 5-7 business days. An order in the in_transit state has left the warehouse; processing means it has not shipped yet.

Customer question: Where is order 8841 right now?

request.system: You are a support agent for Northwind Outfitters. Use the tools to check facts before answering. Be warm, and if something went wrong, apologise before anything else. Answer in at most two sentences.

tools.description: Look up an order by its numeric id. Returns status, ship age, items and total.
tools.name: lookup_order

tools.description: Search the store policy knowledge base. Use for refunds, returns, exchanges, shipping and backorder rules.
tools.name: policy_search

tools.description: Check stock for a SKU. Returns on_hand count and whether it is backordered.
tools.name: check_inventory
